senses.gloss:
खिद् खिद्, cl. 6. P. खिन्दति (Ved. खि-
दति), चिखेद, अखैत्सीत्, खेत्स्यति,
खेत्तुम्, to strike, press, press down; cl. 7. or 4. A.
खिन्त्ते or खिन्ते and खिद्यते, to be pressed down
or depressed, to suffer pain or misery, to be distressed,
to be wearied, to feel tired or exhausted: Caus. खे-
दयति, -यितुम्, to press down, molest, disturb, make
tired or exhausted: Desid. चिखित्सति, -ते: Intens. चे-
खिद्यते, चेखेत्ति; [cf. Lith. zeidziu; Gr. κῆδος?].

खिदिर, अस्, m. an ascetic, a penitent; a pauper;
the moon; an epithet of Indra.

खिद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being depressed, suffer-
ing pain or distress.

खिद्र, अस्, m. a poor man, a pauper; disease,
sickness; (अम्), n., Ved. a press; (Sāy.) an instru-
ment for splitting or dividing.
खिद्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. pressing upon, oppressing.
